intent.objective: Make agentctl approve output-path containment accept an --out path that reaches the repository through a symlinked alias of an ancestor directory
intent.rationale: _contained_destination compares an unresolved destination lexically with the resolved repository root, so an alias path (for example macOS /var versus /private/var, or a Linux symlink to the repository directory) is wrongly rejected as approval_output_outside_repository even though its parent really resolves inside the repository
non_goals: Changing approval policy, schemas, or the approval record format
acceptance_behavior: An --out path that reaches the repository through a symlinked alias of an ancestor directory is accepted when the destination's parent directory really resolves inside the repository
A path whose parent directory truly resolves outside the repository (including through a symlink inside the repository that points outside) is still rejected with approval_output_outside_repository
A destination whose final path component is a symlink is still rejected with approval_output_invalid
A relative --out path still resolves against the repository root and is accepted when it is inside the repository

scope.expected_change_shape: A small change to _contained_destination in approve.py plus one new test module

deterministic_checks: PYTHONPATH=tools/agentctl python3 -m unittest discover -s tools/agentctl/tests -t tools/agentctl -p test_approve_output_containment.py
PYTHONPATH=tools/agentctl python3 -m unittest discover -s tools/agentctl/tests -t tools/agentctl -p 'test_approval*.py'
behavioral_requirements: The new tests build a real symlinked alias directory with tempfile on the real filesystem and do not mock Path
Each of the four acceptance behaviors is exercised by at least one new test
Existing approval tests still pass unchanged
definition_of_done: The candidate passes the deterministic checks, receives an independent review with no blocking findings, and is integrated unchanged

replan_conditions: The fix needs a file outside the writable set
